_comment: Bench fleet registry for tools/bench/identity_guard.py. Operator rules 2026-09-26: no test on a node without its own callsign (never XX0XXX), every callsign SSID unique, bench TX power at most 2 dBm, ESP32 nodes need WiFi, a set clock and the web server. No secrets in this file; WiFi credentials live in ~/MeshCom-bench-backups/. Hosts are the last seen 2323 net-console addresses. REFRESH BEFORE USE: the LAN hands out DHCP leases with a short lease time, so these addresses go stale within hours and get reused by other nodes (2026-10-16: 192.168.68.63, listed for DK5EN-1, had become the production node DK5EN-98). Before any test, find the node by USB serial (identity_guard.py --port) or confirm the callsign on its start page, then update host and last_ip_verified here. A host of null means not known; use --port: a node without a host (RAK = nRF52, T-Deck native USB reports its MAC as the serial number) is checked with --port. DK5EN-1 has its net console off by default (web /setparam/?netconsole=on) and its USB port is held by the soak capture.
